items.question: By what occasion is the weapon dear to yoginīs described to Akṣobhya?
premises: The mention arises by digression from the main topic.
A weapon is being described in this statement.
The described weapon is characterized as dear to the yoginīs.
items.inference: The weapon dear to the yoginīs is described incidentally in an address to Akṣobhya.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the weapon is not named in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Incidentally, O Akṣobhya, the weapon dear to the yoginīs has been described.
